name: Item scaling: a chest opened by a level-scaled character holds its items lifted to the character's content level
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. Dwarf Remains 95673 holds Claw Scarred Mail 450780 at 100%, authored at item level 12 and required level 7 with 86 armor, which this realm places at item level 9 and required level 5. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on meets content at level 27, and a chest lift is the distance from the item to that level: 18, rounded down to a five-level step, 15. The mail it loots is therefore a copy at item level 24 and required level 20, carrying more armor than the authored 86. With scaling off, Underbed Glint 90550 holds the Rootbark Girdle 521000 itself, which this realm places at item level 8. Lock, key and skill checks of the chest are not exercised; client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: The chest holds a copy of Claw Scarred Mail
The copy is lifted to item level 24, fifteen above the nine this realm gives the mail
The copy carries more armor than the authored 86
The looted copy keeps item level 24
The looted copy requires level 20, fifteen above the five this realm asks for the mail
The unscaled chest holds the Rootbark Girdle itself
The unlifted item keeps the item level this realm gives it, 8
